Before: a veggie wrap in two halves (tortilla, cheese slice, avocado, cucumber, slaw, sauce), roughly 300 g and about 550 kcal; two sushi pieces, about 60 g and 90 kcal; soy sauce, about 15 g.

After: the cheese slice was left uneaten (about 20 g, 70 kcal). Most of the soy sauce remains, though a little was used. The water was partly drunk, but it has no calories.

Eaten: about 280 g of wrap at roughly 480 kcal, plus 60 g of sushi at roughly 90 kcal, plus a little soy sauce at about 5 g and 3 kcal. That totals about 345 g and 575 kcal.
